title: Pra'Hyu Suite
description: Quality-of-life tweak suite for Minecraft: freecam, zoom, improved HUD, inventory management, and more, in a single JAR per version.
body:
# Pra'Hyu Suite

Pra'Hyu Suite is a collection of quality-of-life tweaks for Minecraft, designed to make your everyday gameplay smoother and more comfortable. Distributed as a single JAR per version for Fabric, the mod brings together dozens of independent modules that you can enable or disable as you see fit, without ever weighing down your setup.

## Supported Versions

Pra'Hyu Suite is built for Minecraft 1.21 and later versions. Earlier versions are not supported.

## Visual & Camera

**Freecam.** Fully detaches the camera from the player, letting you move freely through the world. Perfect for exploring, filming, or admiring a build from every angle.

**Zoom.** Provides a smooth scroll-wheel zoom with a precisely adjustable level, without ever affecting your regular FOV.

**Fullbright.** Fully illuminates the scene so you can see clearly even in total darkness.

**Clear Lava View.** Removes the fog and the red lava overlay while you're protected by fire resistance.

**Block Overlay.** Highlights the targeted block with a fully customizable outline and fill.

**See Invisible.** Reveals normally invisible players on the client side.

## Inventory & Equipment

**Inventory Manager.** Reimagines inventory management with improved drag-and-drop, smoother scrolling, quick-craft, and automatic highlighting of matching items.

**Tool Changer.** Automatically selects the best available tool before mining or interacting.

**Favorite Slots.** Lets you mark certain slots as favorites so they're never accidentally moved or dropped.

**Elytra Swap.** Instantly swaps between elytra and chestplate with a single keypress.

**Stack Refill.** Automatically replaces an empty stack with an identical one from your inventory.

**Container Preview.** Shows the contents of shulker boxes, ender chests, and bundles as soon as you hover over them.

**Slot Preview.** Gives you a preview of regular inventory slot contents.

**InvMove.** Lets you keep moving even while a container is open.

**Armor Visibility.** Gives you fine control over the opacity of each piece of armor, your cape, and your elytra.

## HUD & Interface

**Mace Meter.** Estimates in real time the damage your mace will deal based on fall height.

**Potion Bar.** Displays all your active potion effects clearly and in a customizable way directly in the HUD.

**Entity Vitals.** Projects entity health bars in 3D within the world, with fully customizable styles and colors.

**Player Locator.** Adds a discreet marker showing the direction of nearby players above your XP bar.

**Keybind Atlas.** Offers an interactive atlas bringing together all your keybinds at a glance.

## Social

**Friend Highlight.** Colors your friends' names in the tab list and above their heads, with a customizable color for each one.

**Macros.** Provides ten fully configurable slots to automate your most-used commands or chat messages.

## Ambiance

**Better Smoke.** Extends the lifespan of campfire smoke particles for a more immersive atmosphere.

**Sea Surface.** Animates the water's surface with realistic splash and foam effects.

**Tools On My Back.** Displays the last tool or weapon you used on your character's back whenever you switch slots.

## Compatibility

**Replay More.** Extends Replay Mod's capabilities by giving you control over time, weather, and FOV during playback.

## Configuration

All settings are managed directly in-game, either through ModMenu if you have it installed, or by simply pressing the H key by default. Each module remains independent and can be enabled, disabled, or customized at your own pace, with keybinds you're free to remap.
